async def gather_values(functions, limit):

    # Run up to 'limit' functions concurrently
    tasks = [func() for func in functions[:limit]]
    results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

    return [result if isinstance(result, Exception) else result for result in results]
